messaging.heroSubtitle: Power your trainable AI agents with seamless data pipelines. Ingest tickets, conversations, and customer data from any support platform with enterprise-grade reliability, built-in replay/backfill, and full observability.
messaging.splashSubtitle: This is where Quack connects to your customer support systems. Ingest tickets, conversations, and interaction data to train your AI agents, powered by SK8.

items.description: Ingest tickets, conversations, and agent data from Zendesk to train your support AI.
